pages.text: The autumn sun sat lower. Shade made it dim beneath the chestnut tree. Spiky shells lay on the ground: chestnut burrs.
"I'll collect chestnuts." Yuki carried a basket to the tree.
Yuki stood at the shade's edge, unable to see inside. "It's dark under there."
Only reaching an arm in, Yuki rolled a burr with a stick. It was empty. "They're all empty here."
Momo entered the shade and scraped through leaves with front paws. Yuki stepped back.
Backing away again, Yuki dropped the basket. It rolled into the shade.
Yuki came home empty-handed. "My basket is in there."
Grandma held Yuki's hand and entered the persimmon tree's shade. Even inside the shade, they could see the whole yard.
Yuki walked into the chestnut tree's shade. The basket still lay on the leaves. "Here it is!"
Yuki pressed a burr with a foot. It split open, revealing shiny chestnuts.
